lead.headline: BUN SHIPS BUN-V1.3.14
lead.deck: Bun v1.3.14 has been released with updates from 11 contributors
lead.body: The latest version of Bun, a JavaScript runtime, has been updated with new features and improvements. According to the release notes, the changes are the result of collaborative efforts from a diverse group of contributors. While specific details of the updates are not provided, the release is likely to bring performance enhancements, bug fixes, and other refinements that will make the development process more efficient and reliable for users. The release also includes a link to the full release notes on Bun's blog, where developers can learn more about the specific changes and their implications. As a result, developers can expect a smoother and more productive experience with Bun v1.3.14
